goal: Test whether comparing output and clean speech through the same frozen five-component formula repairs proxy-target inconsistency and improves Exact medians without harming SI-SDR.
authorization: User requests continued repair of SI-SDR and six-component median errors; bounded tests and repairs remain authorized.
task: Preserve the same patient's clean pathological waveform and six voice components while enhancing the fixed degraded recording.
dataset: Reuse only the existing hash-bound TAU cohort and original source waveforms; no new speakers, recipes, seeds or SVD tests.
split: Four original train cases, four original validation cases; the 96 evaluation rows remain excluded from all optimizer updates and repair selection.
baseline: S3_500 with the already-verified stable magnitude decoder and common peak safeguard; every arm starts from the same original checkpoint.

alignment.delay_source: the exact sealed recipe RIR resampled by the original WdsReader

primary_metric: All six individual Exact normalized absolute-gap reduction medians and fixed-reference SI-SDR, reported separately for the fixed four training and four development-validation cases.
guardrails: Original unaligned scores retained; finite outputs, magnitude and gradients; peak <=0.95; gain and waveform-identity drift; held-out optimizer steps zero; unchanged six-gradient gate for joint arm.
expected_failure_modes: Clean-reference bias cancellation may not transfer from clean to degraded speech; model parameter propagation and AdamW can reverse component descent; four-example generalization and phase errors may remain.
unacceptable_mistakes: Using validation or reserve outcomes to fit references or select checkpoints; changing Exact targets or reference polarity, gain, lag; substituting legacy Shimmer dB; claiming identity consistency proves Exact gradient fidelity.
next_experiment: One new 128-step arm versus the completed aligned_joint_bounded v3 control. Change only the five differentiable clean reference values. Preserve Candidate-E Exact Shimmer dB target, formulas, frozen weights, fidelity, 0.5 parameter budget, initialization, data order and all optimizer settings.
rollback: Original code branch, all prior checkpoints, raw waveforms and scores remain available; every arm and any failure gets a distinct run directory.

rejected_alignment_audit.reason: Input cross-correlation picks model-incompatible reflection or pitch-period peaks. Restore the canonical pretraining RIR delay definition instead of optimizing correlation.

auxiliary_balance_rationale: A common positive attenuation leaves all six internal directions and relative weights intact. The 0.5 norm budget guarantees at least 0.5 of the raw fidelity directional derivative before AdamW, by the Cauchy-Schwarz bound. It is an engineering bound, not a validation-score-fitted coefficient or an AdamW descent guarantee.

repair_acceptance.failure_action: Keep the trial and report unresolved regressions; do not promote to longer training.

reference_repair.method: Use the same frozen differentiable scorer on each training clean waveform and each current output. The per-component target is F(clean), giving zero identity gap up to float roundoff. Exact(clean) stays the final evaluation target.
reference_repair.candidate_e_db: Unchanged Exact target; no clean-target topology request.
reference_repair.source_cases: Only the original four training rows; anchors recomputed and sealed before optimizer step 1.
reference_repair.rationale: Fixed-formula clean identity bias is a training-coordinate inconsistency, especially Shimmer percent and tilt. This is not a claim that proxy-minus-proxy predicts all Exact changes.
